newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf rigs under contract down 2 at 161.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf rigs under contract down 2 at 161.

text.p: There were 161 rigs under contract in the U.S. Gulf as of December 20, down two from the prior week, Offshore Data Services said.
The utilization rate for rigs working in the Gulf, based on a total fleet of 179, was 89.9 percent.
The number of working rigs in European/Mediterranean remained the same this week at 105 rigs under contract out of a total fleet of 105, a utilization rate of 100 percent.
The worldwide rig count fell three to 558 out of a total fleet of 605, making the utilization rate 92.2 percent.
